_readme: Structured list rendered IN FULL in every Wed/Sun digest. Fields: id,name,type,url,apply_url,event_date,deadline (ISO),location,format (in-person|online|hybrid),season (fall|winter|spring|summer|rolling),travel,prizes,perks,eligibility,notes. filters.hide_seasons is empty, so nothing is hidden by season. Add entries here or ask Claude to.

opportunities.name: Cornell Trading Competition 2026
